# Spain terrestrial fixture

Small subset extracted from the live MITECO REST feed on **2026-08-17**.

- Source: `https://sedeaplicaciones.minetur.gob.es/ServiciosRESTCarburantes/PreciosCarburantes/EstacionesTerrestres/`
- Contents: 3 Madrid-province stations, 2 other provinces, 1 intentionally malformed row
- Format matches official JSON (`Fecha`, `ListaEESSPrecio`, comma decimals)

Do not commit full government datasets.
